bigPicture: The AI industry is shifting from 'which model is best' to 'which harness controls the workflow' — framework lock-in is replacing model lock-in as the real strategic risk, while coding agents go mainstream faster than anyone expected.

emerging.signal: Harrison Chase, Emad Mostaque, and Cursor are all circling the same fight: whoever controls the harness layer between models and users wins the next platform war — and model providers know it.

Harvard proving o1 outperforms ER doctors on triage plus Google DeepMind launching a co-clinician initiative in the same week signals healthcare is the first domain where agent autonomy will be normalized, not debated.

Greg Isenberg's 'buy dead SaaS + agent-ify' playbook plus YC's leaked AI company blueprint are converging on a new meta: the fastest path to $1M isn't building from scratch, it's acquiring distribution and replacing the backend with agents.
